label: No

label: Yes

label: Matatabi (Two Tails)
description: Blue flame cat; grants blue fire and feline agility.

label: Isobu (Three Tails)
description: Water beast; grants water release and coral armor.

label: Son Gokū (Four Tails)
description: Lava ape; grants lava release and immense physical strength.

label: Kokuō (Five Tails)
description: Steam beast; grants steam release and charging power.

label: Saiken (Six Tails)
description: Slug beast; grants corrosive slime and chemical resistance.

label: Chōmei (Seven Tails)
description: Insect beast; grants flight and scale powder.

label: Gyūki (Eight Tails)
description: Octopus-ox beast; grants ink techniques and tentacle power.

label: Kurama (Nine Tails)
description: King of the tailed beasts; grants the largest biju chakra reserves.

label: Poor Control
description: The beast is barely contained; chakra leaks frequently.

label: Low Control
description: Limited control; the beast sometimes takes over.

label: Excellent Control
description: High synchronization with the tailed beast.

label: Perfect Control
description: Complete synchronization; jinchuriki and beast act as one.
